newsitem.title: COLOMBIA: RESEARCH ALERT-BAVARIA MAINTAINED AS BUY.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT-BAVARIA MAINTAINED AS BUY.

text.p: ING Barings maintained its buy recommendation on Colombian brewing giant Bavaria, citing its "outstanding operating income growth" in the second quarter.
-- ING Barings said the 45.3 percent year-on-year growth in earnings per share in dollar terms was 31.7 percent above its estimates.

-- Bavaria posted second quarter operating profits of $22.9 million, up 269 percent year-on-year, according to ING Barings, and boosted its operating margin to 11.2 percent in the second quarter this year from 3.7 percent in the same period last year.
-- The investment research group upgraded its earning per share estimate in dollar terms for 1997 to $0.85 from $0.84 and increased the forecast to $0.93 from $0.92 for 1998.
-- It maintained the price target for Bavaria shares in dollar terms at $11 by June 1998.
-- Bavaria is currently preparing a stock split to divide the brewing business from the holdings division.

-- "The upcoming stock split should unveil hidden value...and would allow the domestic market to value each of Bavaria's main divisions separately. A split could be the first step toward possible corporate actions within the group, including further acquisitions, mergers and company listings," ING Barings said.
